message: Your article makes me think of the supposed law of our  land: "Innocent until proven guilty". It seems you can harshly judged and thought guilty before the facts are in. Now sometime people do live on the edge and do things like a teeter todder. They can fall one way or the other. They live their life like walking blind folded along a cliff side. Now if they are found guilty then we think they just deserve it by the way they live. But for those who try to stay away and live their life far from the cliff. They seek to do what is right. They honestly prefer to be fair and just in what they do. They are not the gambling type but more or less follow the rules of society. But in some case or situation are found or pronounced guilty when in fact they are not at all. That seems the most unfariest justice. I think of all the articles written online to date. I think there comes a time when it becomes saturated and so call unique writing is hard to determine. They say you are just copying but in fact you have written a unique article. But it is not seen as such but you arre condemened on the spot without proven evidence. I know of a person who is in prision who feels resentment today because as he has stated he is innocent of the crime. How terrible to be innocent yet found guilty of something you had no part in. Where is the justice? Who can you trust? Who is say they are right at any given time. It is frightening what can prevail nowadays. I feel for those who are unjustly convicted. And feel sorry for those who violate by their always living on the edge and getting away with it and possibly wrongly troubling the innocent party.
